description: This PHP source file is part of a web interface for a home network gateway wizard. It includes several HTML, JavaScript, and PHP components to handle user interactions for setting a new password during a multi-step setup process. The file manages form validation, toggling password visibility, and client-server communication for password update confirmation.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the instance number based on the current username, mapping specific usernames to numeric instance identifiers.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to save the new password configuration and handles the response to proceed or show errors.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Collects user input for old and new passwords, performs validation, and initiates a configuration update.
